findings.quote: shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim
findings.rationale: Because "Fees" is defined as only the USD 12,000 Implementation Fee and the cap references the first Order Form, the cap collapses to ~$12k; also Customer's liability is uncapped for broad Excluded Claims with no super-cap tier.

replacement.oldText: shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim
replacement.newText: shall not exceed the greater of (i) USD [___] and (ii) the total Fees paid or payable under all Order Forms during the twelve months preceding the first event giving rise to liability
replacement.comment: P1-A: cap collapses to ~$12k due to Fees definition; also two-tier the cap per P1-F.

findings.quote: an amount equal to fifteen percent of the annual Fees for each week the invoice remains unpaid
findings.rationale: Penalty rather than genuine pre-estimate (>780% annualized) and conflicts with §7.3 good-faith withholding.

replacement.oldText: If any invoice is not paid within ten days of its due date, Customer shall pay Vendor, as liquidated damages and not as a penalty, an amount equal to fifteen percent of the annual Fees for each week the invoice remains unpaid.
replacement.newText: Undisputed amounts remaining unpaid more than ten business days after written notice of non-payment accrue interest at the lesser of 1% per month and the maximum rate permitted by law. Interest does not accrue on amounts disputed in good faith under Section 7.3.

findings.quote: or train a generally available model on it without Customer's express written consent
findings.rationale: Model-training restriction limited to generally available models, leaving internal/private model training permitted; telemetry carve-out needs re-identification covenant.

replacement.oldText: or train a generally available model on it without Customer's express written consent
replacement.newText: or use Customer Data to train, fine-tune, or evaluate any machine-learning or AI model without Customer's express written consent

findings.quote: Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities
findings.rationale: Audit rights are asymmetric — Vendor may audit Customer but Customer has no audit/assurance rights; §23 heading is empty and should be populated with SOC 2, security assessment, and invoice audit rights.

findings.quote: Vendor warrants that Fees charged to Customer will be no less favourable than fees offered to any similarly situated customer
findings.rationale: MFN favours Customer but is unenforceable as drafted: no definition of "similarly situated" and no audit/true-up remedy.

findings.quote: Vendor shall not develop or market a service that competes directly with Customer's proprietary analytics products during the term.
findings.rationale: Vendor-side non-compete is broad, untethered to Confidential Information, raises enforceability/competition concerns and invites reciprocity demands.

replacement.oldText: Vendor shall not develop or market a service that competes directly with Customer's proprietary analytics products during the term.
replacement.newText: Vendor shall not use Customer Confidential Information or Deliverables to develop or market a product or service that competes with Customer's proprietary analytics products.

findings.quote: professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000
findings.rationale: E&O limit light for a hosted platform; cancellation notice only "to the extent available"; no additional insured, waiver of subrogation, or extended reporting period.

findings.quote: will not contain malicious code intentionally introduced by Vendor
findings.rationale: Malicious-code warranty too narrow and §19.4 repair period is open-ended ("reasonable period") without an outer limit.

findings.quote: provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at the rates in the expiring Order Form
findings.rationale: Rates may not exist; export only on request; no self-service export or insolvency escrow trigger, leaving data stranded on §9.2 termination.

findings.quote: refund prepaid and implementation Fees on a straight-line three-year basis
findings.rationale: Straight-line three-year amortization understates refund for perpetual/paid-up items licensed under §13.2.

findings.quote: unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal
findings.rationale: Auto-renewal with 30-day window; email alone insufficient for notice — calendar deadlines and permit acknowledged email.

findings.quote: Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form without cause
findings.rationale: Termination for convenience is favourable to Customer; protect in negotiation.

findings.quote: No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies.
findings.rationale: No minimum commitment; review raises no issue.

findings.quote: perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence
findings.rationale: Licence scope favourable; only related concern is refund treatment under §20.5.

findings.quote: governed by the laws of the State of New York
findings.rationale: Review raises no objection to New York law and venue.

findings.quote: Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent
findings.rationale: Assignment and change-of-control terms are Customer-favourable; no issue raised.

findings.quote: Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment
hiring any person who responds to general recruitment
